door.aim: Point at the QR. Nothing to tap.
door.photoOn: The entry photo takes itself when the scan goes through.

camera.denied: We can't get at the camera. Allow it in your browser settings, or check people in by name.
camera.missing: This device has no camera. Check people in by name.
camera.failed: The camera would not start. Check people in by name.

door.searchName: Type and they appear. Three letters is enough.
door.nobodyExpected: Nobody has signed up or come in yet.
door.noMatch: No name like that. Try the surname. If they are not there, have them ask to join and approve it tomorrow.
door.pointsLede: Tick whoever helped and tap the reason. Two taps and done.
door.nobodyHere: Nobody has come in yet. Points go to people who are already here.
door.pointsUndo: Points land straight away. If you get it wrong you can take them off from that person’s profile.
door.rosterRefused: The list came back empty, which is what happens when you no longer have access. Sign in again, and if it stays like this ask somebody on the committee.
door.pointsUnavailable: We could not read what each reason is worth. Without that the points would be wrong.

invited.title: You're invited
invited.lede: Somebody in the group sent you the link. Sign in with your Google account and you are one of us. No new password.
invited.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. The invitation is what grants access, and the committee can cut it off if it leaks.

open.title: Ask to join
open.lede: You got here without an invitation. Sign in with Google and the committee will let you in by hand, usually the same day.
open.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. Until you are approved you can see the events, but you cannot sign up for them.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.lede: We sent it to {{email}}. If it isn't there, check spam.
sent.link: Tap the link in the email and you're in.
sent.orCode: Or, if you prefer, type the six-digit code in that same email.
sent.linkOpensSafari: The link opens Safari, and from there you would not end up in here. Type the code and it works first time.

errors.sendFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.badCode: That code is not right, or it has expired. Ask for another.
errors.googleFailed: We could not reach Google. Please try again in a moment.

entry.stranded: It looks like you signed in but the session stayed in the browser rather than here. Open the app from Safari, or tell the committee and we will sort it out.
entry.emailFallback: Or, if Google is not working for you, sign in with your email.

errors.generic: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't get through. Check your signal and try again.
errors.offline: You need to be online for this.
errors.forbidden: That one isn't yours to do.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a row. Give it a couple of minutes.

event.fullNoQueue: Nobody is waiting yet. Join the list and you are first if somebody drops out.
event.fullWithQueue_one: {{count}} person is waiting. People always drop out.
event.fullWithQueue_other: {{count}} are waiting. People always drop out.

ask.title: Coming? Say so now, even if it is a maybe
ask.full: No places left. You can join the waiting list
ask.yesWarning: If you say yes, your face goes on the list above and everybody sees it.
ask.yesPublic: Your face is on the list above.
ask.privateAnswer: Maybes and can't-makes go to the committee only.
ask.queuePrivate: Being on the list does not show anywhere. Only the committee sees it.
ask.queueWarning: Joining the list does not show anywhere. If a place frees up, the committee will tell you.

queue.onList: You are on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the committee will tell you.
queue.position: You are {{position}} on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the committee will tell you.

gone.title: Nothing here
gone.body: This event is gone, or you cannot see it yet. Go back and see what is on.

said.yesSub: Change it whenever you like, but say so early: the committee is counting on you.
said.maybe: You said maybe. We are holding your place.
said.maybeSub: If it turns out you can’t, say so and the place goes to someone else.
said.noSub: If you change your mind, come back while there are places left.
said.nothing: You have not said anything yet.
said.nothingSub: Three taps and you are done. Maybe counts too.

rank.nudge: Nobody above you is slowing down.

recap.title: Last time
recap.were_one: {{count}} was there and we still laugh about it
recap.were_other: {{count}} of us were there and we still laugh about it

upcoming.title: What else is coming
upcoming.thatIsAll: And after that, nothing yet. Relax, something will turn up.
upcoming.none: Nothing else on the calendar yet. Relax, something will turn up.

empty.title: Nothing right now
empty.body: There is nothing on the calendar. Relax, something will turn up.

waiting.banner: You are still on the waiting list. You can see what is coming, but you cannot sign up until the committee lets you in.

install.title: Put it on your screen
install.lede: Two taps and it behaves like a real app. Without it there are no alerts when places open, and they will go to someone else.

step1.title: Tap Share, at the bottom
step1.body: It's the little square with the arrow pointing up, in the middle of the Safari bar.

step2.title: Scroll down to "Add to Home Screen"
step2.body: It's further down the list. Then Add, top right.

payoff.title: What you get
payoff.body: Alerts when places open, your QR without hunting for it, and full screen. In a normal browser tab the alerts never arrive: that's Apple, not us.

install.laterWarning: You can carry on here in the browser. Once you add it to your home screen you'll sign in one more time, because the iPhone treats them as two separate things.
install.iconPreview: This is how it will sit among your apps. The red icon is easy to spot when you are in a hurry.

junta.title: Committee area
junta.newEventSub: Or copy an earlier one and change the date
junta.invitesSub: The group code and who wants in
junta.paymentsSub: Mark who has paid and name admins
junta.noEvents: Nothing on the calendar yet. Create the first one.
junta.youAreAdmin: You are an admin: you can create events, check people in, give points and name other admins.
junta.youAreOwner: You are the owner: on top of what an admin does, you can take points away and hand over the owner role.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.oneCode: One code per group, that is all. If it leaks, kill it and make another.
invites.shareText: Join us: {{link}} — the code is {{code}}. Sign in with Google and that is it.
invites.killAndRemake: Kill this code and make another
invites.killExplains: Anybody already in stays in. It only stops working for new people.
invites.none: There is no active code right now. Nobody can get in by invitation.
invites.askFirst: If you do not know the name, ask the group before letting them in. Better to take a day than to have strangers in the ranking.

payments.title: Payments and committee
payments.bizum: The money still moves the way it always has. This is only so nobody ends up keeping a spreadsheet on their phone.
payments.nobody: Nobody has signed up yet. They appear here once they say yes.
payments.chaseThem: Anyone still unpaid on Friday morning, message them yourself. The group chat does not work.
payments.handover: When you hand over in June, name the next lot before you go. Otherwise nobody can create anything next year.
payments.adminCan: An admin can create events, check people in and award points. Have three or four, not one.

form.coverEmpty: Tap to add the cover photo
form.coverHint: Landscape, with people in it. That is what makes people tap through.
form.name: What it is called
form.what: What kind of thing it is
form.wherePlaceholder: The place and how to get there
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What there will be, who is playing, what to bring
form.transportHint: Always write this. It is the question the group asks most.
form.transportPlaceholder: The last train, the night bus, who is driving
form.revealSub: Publish it covered: until the time you set, people see the teaser and the countdown.
form.teaserHint: Enough to intrigue and no more. Explain it and there is nothing left to reveal.
form.teaserPlaceholder: Keep the weekend of the 14th free
form.previewNoDate: Set a time and it opens by itself
form.previewHiddenFields: The place, the description, the cover and getting home: hidden until then.
form.publishNow: It appears on everyone's Home straight away.
form.publishHidden: It opens by itself at the time you set. Nothing else to do.
form.saveChangesNote: It is already on everyone's Home: the change shows straight away.

onboarding.title: You're in
onboarding.lede: Four things and you are in. We already have your name and photo from Google — check they look right.
onboarding.nameHint: Use the name people call you here, not the one on your ID.

school.label: Your school
school.lede: Your points go to your school. The three of them compete all year.

phone.label: Phone
phone.why: Only so we can add you to the WhatsApp group. It does not appear on your profile and nobody outside the committee sees it.
phone.invalid: That number does not look right. Leave it blank if you would rather not.

cta.pickSchool: Pick a school and you are in

onboarding.later: You can change all of this later in your profile.

breakdown.title: Where the points came from
breakdown.empty: No points yet. Come to something and this fills itself in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.public: Show me in the public ranking
settings.publicOn: You appear with your name and face.
settings.publicOff: You do not appear, but your points still count for your school.

qr.offlineOk: Brightness up · works with no signal
qr.howTo: Show it at the door and wait for the beep. If the screen is smudged, give it a wipe.
qr.unavailable: We cannot show your code right now. Try once with a connection and it will be saved for next time.

ranking.schoolsLede: Everything you do counts for your school, whether you are 3rd or 60th.
ranking.cutOff: That is as far as the list goes. If you cannot see yourself, you need to get out more.
ranking.nothingYet: Nobody has any points yet. The first event gets it started.

scanner.okWalkin: Not on the list, but come on in
scanner.okWalkinReview: Let them in — not signed up and not paid
scanner.alreadyCheckedIn: This QR has already been used
scanner.notAMember: This QR isn't one of ours
scanner.queued: Saved. It will send once there's signal

action.okWalkin: They were not signed up. It is recorded now.
action.okWalkinReview: Check they pay on the way in, or note it down.
action.alreadyCheckedIn: They already came through. If they insist, check the manual list.
action.notAMember: Ask their name and find them by hand. Do not wave them through unrecorded.
action.memberInactive: Have them ask to join. You approve it tomorrow from the junta area.
action.eventNotOpen: Check this is the right event and that it is published.
action.error: Keep scanning. It sends itself when the signal comes back.

state.empty: Nothing right now. Something will turn up
